notes: No Portuguese food-truck / roulote / event ordering tool exists that I could find (searches return only foreign guides, App Store apps and marketplaces). NEW: two genuine Portuguese restaurant online-ordering tools with € prices on their own sites: Takego (Takeaway & Delivery 99,99€/mês, Total 149,99€/mês, scheduling up to 7 days ahead, 0% commission) and SQV / Sistema Que Vende (Loja Online + App 100,80€/mês + IVA, 129,90€/mês with bookings; adesão 399,90€; 'para agora ou agendado'). SumUp pt-pt online store (recolha na loja, 0 €/mês + 2,75 %) kept as the generic fallback. Choice /pt/pricing 403. 'GlobalFood Menu' (an old article's 'first Portuguese free ordering platform') could not be found — likely a GloriaFood rebrand; GloriaFood itself was found not relevant for PT in compare-research-1 (USD, Brazil-only Portuguese pages, end of life). WinRest / ZoneSoft show no public online-ordering price. MENU TIGER (agent 2) has a /pt site with USD prices only. Takego shows no IVA statement. Storekit (owned by agent 1): its supported-regions doc lists Portugal (Portuguese, EUR payments), but prices are GBP only, so it is recorded and not counted.
